chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya and Ahmad ibn Idris, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from al-Hasan ibn al-Husayn, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan al-Maythami, from Fayd ibn al-Mukhtar.

In a lengthy hadith regarding the matter of Abu al-Hasan (عليه السلام), until Abu Abdillah (عليه السلام) said to him: “He is your master whom you asked about, so stand before him and acknowledge his right.”
So I stood and kissed his head and his hand, and I made du'a to Allah, Mighty and Majestic, for him.

Then Abu Abdillah (عليه السلام) said: “Indeed, we had not been given permission regarding this before you.” He said: I said, “May I be your ransom, should I inform anyone of it?” He said: “Yes, your family and your children.” My family, my children, and my companions were with me, and Yunus ibn Zibyan was among my companions. So when I informed them, they praised Allah, Mighty and Majestic, and Yunus said: “No, by Allah, not until I hear that from him.” He was hasty in this, so he went out and I followed him.

So when I reached the door, I heard Abu Abdillah (عليه السلام) saying to him—he had reached him before me: “O Yunus, the matter is as Fayd told you.” He said: So he said, “I have heard and obeyed.” Then Abu Abdillah (عليه السلام) said to me: “Take him with you, O Fayd.”

key_terms.أَمْرِ: the affair or matter under discussion, referring here to the designation of authority
key_terms.بِحَقِّهِ: his due right, meaning his acknowledged entitlement
key_terms.دَعَوْتُ: I supplicated, meaning I made du'a
key_terms.سَمِعْتُ وَأَطَعْتُ: I heard and obeyed, expressing acceptance and submission
key_terms.صَاحِبُكَ: your master or rightful authority whom the question concerned

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith describe the recognition of Imam Musa al-Kazim (عليه السلام) after Imam al-Sadiq (عليه السلام)?
ai.summary: This report narrates the explicit designation of Abu al-Hasan Musa (عليه السلام) and Fayd ibn al-Mukhtar’s acknowledgment of his right. It also shows that this matter was initially disclosed in a restricted manner, limited to close family, before being confirmed directly to Yunus ibn Zibyan by Abu Abdillah (عليه السلام).

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya and Ahmad Bin Idrees, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Al Hassan Bin Al Husayn, from Ahmad Bin Al Hassan Al Maysami, from Fayz Bin Al Mukhtar,

‘In a lengthy Hadeeth regarding the command of Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, until Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said to him: ‘He<sup>asws</sup> is your Master<sup>asws</sup> whom you asked about, therefore stand and go to him<sup>asws</sup> and acknowledge to him<sup>asws</sup> of his<sup>asws</sup> right’.
So I stood until I kissed his<sup>asws</sup> head and his<sup>asws</sup> hand, and I supplicated to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic for him<sup>asws</sup>.

So Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘But, it was not Permitted for us<sup>asws</sup> at first before you’. I said, ‘May I be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>! So, should I inform anyone (else) with it?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes, your wife and your children’. And it was so that with me was my wife and children and my friends, and it was so that Yunus Bin Zibyan was from my friends. So when I informed them, they Praised Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic and Yunus said, ‘No, by Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, until I hear that from him<sup>asws</sup>’, and there was a haste with him. So he went out, and I followed him.

So when I ended up to the door, I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying to him: ‘And you have preceded me<sup>asws</sup> to it, O Yunus. The matter is as Fayz has said to you’. So he said, ‘I have heard, and I shall obey’. So Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘Take him with you, O Fayz’.
en.sarwar: 9. Muhammad ibn Yahya and Ahmad ibn Idris have narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Abd al-Jabbar from al-Hassan ibn al-Husayn from Ahmad ibn al-Hassan al-Maythami from Fayd ibn al-Mukhtar,
in a lengthy hadith on the affair of abu al-Hassan (a.s.). In it abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) has said to the narrator. “He is your Master of who you asked. Stand up for him and acknowledge his rights.”
I then stood up and kissed his head and hand and prayed to Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High, for him.”

Abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) then said, “Keep in mind that permission is not given to us to speak about him to anyone before you.” The narrator has said that he then said to the Imam (a.s.), “‘May Allah take my soul in service for your cause, can I inform any one about him?” The Imam (a.s.) said, “Yes, you may inform your family (wife) and sons.” With me there were my family (wife), sons and friends and of my friends there was Yunus ibn al_Zabyan. When I informed them they all thanked Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High. Yunus said, “No, by Allah, I must hear that from him. He was in a hurry. He went and I followed him.

When I reached the door I heard abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) say to him,- he had reached him before I-, “What Fayd has said to you is true.” The narrator has said that he (Yunus) then said, “I have heard it and I have obeyed.” Abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) then said, “Take him with you, O Fayd.”
